Embedded JavaScript parser for the limited EditorsHub expression language. It is not permission to run unrestricted JavaScript.
Media read/write, demux/mux, decoders and the export pipeline. Loaded on demand from a CDN; not downloaded when the credits page opens. Source links point to the version in use.

Adapts camera solve, KLT, robust fitting, geometry and bundle adjustment to Web Workers/WASM. Uses the MIT option from MIT OR Apache-2.0. Complete embedded Rust dependency notices are included; the EffectCraft UI, renderer, codecs and assets are not bundled.
Trained model for portrait background removal. ONNX weights are fetched only when the feature is used; EditorsHub does not train this model. The weight source is pinned to revision 0c91c39f.
MODNet project
WebAssembly inference runtime for MODNet. Loaded on demand in a worker; opening the credits does not download or run the model.
Project thumbnails on Home and configurable keyboard shortcut contributions. Original contribution credit is kept.
